reason: Credit support under the AI-cloud programme is one programme of q09's total of financing commitments and backstops, and both are read from the same FY2027 annual filing, so the date is the same.
Both ask whether NVIDIA signs a guarantee of OpenAI's Ohio data-center lease; July 1, 2027 against 2027-06-30 is the same event under another deadline.
Both ask whether NVIDIA begins shipping Rubin (Vera Rubin) by December 31, 2026.
Both ask for NVIDIA's reported total revenue for FY2027.
Both ask for NVIDIA's reported total revenue for FY2028.
Both ask for the combined calendar-2026 data-center capex of the four largest AI hyperscalers; only the due date differs, and the same reported figure settles both.
Both ask for the combined calendar-2027 data-center capex of the largest (big four) AI hyperscalers; the same reported figure settles both.

Both ask whether Chinese authorities authorize Chinese firms to import NVIDIA H200 chips; December 31, 2026 against January 31, 2027 is the same event under another deadline.
